source.title: Public data gateway terms and conditions

rights.terms: Gateway website content states Open Government Licence v3.0; linked datasets retain their own terms
rights.permitted_destination: research-only metadata, links, and terms receipt

disposition.rationale: Authorizes reuse of gateway content but is not blanket permission for every linked payload.
disposition.contingency: Review the exact dataset licence before any payload retrieval.
disposition.refresh_or_retry_condition: Refresh before access/release and whenever displayed terms change.
